collection.title: Vauxhall Insignia Sports Tourer 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall Insignia Sports Tourer 2017 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Insignia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
